title: Hybrid lexical arm contributes nothing on develop: identifier retrieval regressed 5/5 to 0/5
description:
The identifier category — the headline achievement of this initiative — scores **0/5 on `develop` today**. Fix this before trusting any other retrieval measurement.

## Evidence

| Report | commit | identifier | MRR |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| `retrieval_baseline.json` (pre-hybrid) | — | 0/5 | 0.6533 |
| `retrieval_post_hybrid_a61c12.json` | a61c12 | **5/5** | 0.8533 |
| `retrieval_post_recency_bb12d3.json` | bb12d3 | **5/5** | 0.8533 |
| `retrieval_post_pubdate_bfc2f3.json` | bfc2f33, 2026-07-27 | **0/5** | 0.6533 |

Reproduced on parent `beab60a` under the same environment, so it is **not** caused by the prefer-publication-date change. The four non-identifier categories are bit-identical throughout.

**The MRR is exactly the pre-hybrid baseline — 0.6533, to four decimals.** That is the tell. This is not a degraded lexical arm returning weaker hits; the system is scoring as though the lexical arm contributes *nothing at all*. Fusion is running with one arm.

## Leading hypothesis, in the order worth checking

1. **The lexical artifact was overwritten with a subset.** Closed bug `9b6971` — "`knowledge-vector-index --reference-id` rebuilds lexical index for that subset only" — describes exactly this failure. The bug is closed, but closing the code path does not repair an artifact already clobbered by it. Check `corpora/knowledge-index/lexical/v1/index.json.gz`: how many documents does it actually contain? Compare against 1376 accepted in `knowledge-corpus-ai-ml-research`.
   - Note `assert_lexical_promote_safe` (`LEXICAL_SHRINK_GUARD_RATIO = 0.5`, `MIN_EXISTING = 10`) only blocks a shrink *below half*. A subset rebuild of 60% passes the guard silently. And the guard cannot fire at all on a path that does not call it.
2. **The artifact is missing or unreadable from the eval environment** — wrong bucket, wrong prefix, credentials, region. If the loader swallows that and falls back to semantic-only, it would produce exactly this signature. **If a silent fallback exists, that is a second bug: it must fail loudly.**
3. **The long-standing corpus gap.** The initiative has carried an unexplained "99-reference gap between the lexical artifact (1321) and the live accepted corpus (1420)" since `a61c12` landed. It was never explained. Accepted is now 1376. Resolve this number properly rather than noting it again.

## Acceptance

- Identifier back to **5/5**, global MRR ≈ **0.8533**, on `develop`, in a report committed with the usual provenance block.
- State the lexical artifact's document count and the accepted-reference count **in the report note**, as two explicit numbers. This gap has been carried as a footnote for weeks; make it a measured field so drift is visible next time.
- If the cause was a silent fallback or a guard that could not fire, fix that too and add a test. An index that quietly serves nothing is the recurring failure mode of this whole initiative: silent partial work that looks like success.

## Do not

- Do not re-tune ranking weights to recover MRR. The retrieval logic is not what changed.
- Do not rebuild the lexical artifact until you have recorded what the current one contains. The broken state is the evidence.

comments.text:
## Investigation update (2026-07-27) — do not rebuild yet

Checked live artifact first (per acceptance: broken state is evidence).

### Lexical artifact is intact (hypothesis 1 rejected for current object)

`s3://amplify-dbsyytcm9drqa-mai-papyrusmediabucket0dab24-4hstaautjdqo/corpora/knowledge-index/lexical/v1/index.json.gz`
(last modified 2026-07-26T19:39:26Z):

| Field | Value |
|---|---:|
| docs/chunks | **5658** |
| unique referenceLineageId | **1321** |
| eligibleCount | **1376** |
| skipped missing_extracted_text | **55** |

BM25 against this file ranks all 5 golden identifier queries at **rank 1**. Eval retrieved lists for those queries match **pre-hybrid / semantic-only** order. So the arm is not reading trash — it is **not contributing at query time**.

### Loader vs hybrid path

- `load_lexical_artifact`: fails loudly (missing path/bucket / S3 errors propagate).
- `_hybrid_semantic_search`: catches lexical exceptions, appends `Lexical search unavailable: …`, returns semantic-only. **That silent fallback matches the observed signature** (identifier 0/5, MRR 0.6533).
- Additional gap: if `lexical_provider` is `None` (no bucket / no `PAPYRUS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME` / no amplify_outputs bucket), the lexical future is **never submitted** and previously produced **no warning at all**.

### Next checks (still open)

Why the eval/process did not get lexical hits: bucket/env for `BM25LexicalProvider`, swallowed exception in warnings, or provider `None`. Do **not** rebuild the artifact until that is recorded.

### Related work in flight on TI-5ed2f2

Eval harness will set `PAPYRUS_REQUIRE_LEXICAL=1` and preflight lexical floors so this failure mode cannot produce a “valid” golden report. Engine raises under that flag; default runtime still falls back with a warning (now also when provider is missing).

comments.text:
## Root cause confirmed (2026-07-28)

Reproduced both arms in the ranking worktree (no `amplify_outputs.json` here):

| Condition | `services.lexical` | identifier `1707.03141` expected rank |
|---|---|---:|
| `PAPYRUS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME` = Papyrus-main media bucket | `bm25-lexical` | **1** (fusion `lexicalRank=1`) |
| Bucket unset + no amplify_outputs | **`None`** | **-1** (semantic-only; no fusion) |

Hypothesis 1 (clobbered artifact) remains rejected. Hypothesis 2 confirmed: **lexical provider never constructed**, so hybrid never runs. Before the TI-5ed2f2 warning, this produced **zero warnings** — the eval looked healthy and scored as pre-hybrid (MRR 0.6533).

The broken `retrieval_post_pubdate_bfc2f3.json` run had vector ARN + GraphQL but no storage bucket in provenance; that matches.

### Fix in flight
1. Eval env profile always sets `PAPYRUS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME` + `PAPYRUS_REQUIRE_LEXICAL` (TI-5ed2f2 harness).
2. Engine warns (raises under require flag) when provider is missing.
3. Re-run golden eval; report will include lexical docs/refs counts; target identifier 5/5.

comments.text:
## Fixed — identifier 5/5 restored (env + fail-loud)

### Root cause
Ranking worktree had **no** `amplify_outputs.json` and eval runs often lacked `PAPYRUS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME`. `build_environment_services()` then set `lexical=None`. Hybrid never ran; before TI-5ed2f2 there was **no warning**. Signature matched pre-hybrid: identifier 0/5, MRR 0.6533. Artifact was never clobbered (5658 docs / 1321 refs intact).

### Fix
1. Pinned eval env `papyrus-main-ai-ml-readonly` always supplies the Papyrus-main media bucket + `PAPYRUS_REQUIRE_LEXICAL=1`.
2. Engine warns when provider is missing; raises under `PAPYRUS_REQUIRE_LEXICAL`.
3. `build_environment_services` raises early under that flag if no lexical provider can be built.
4. Harness preflights lexical floors and aborts on lexical-unavailable warnings.

### Verification report
`procedures/newsroom/tests/fixtures/reports/retrieval_post_b9f6da_lexical_env.json`

| Field | Value |
|---|---:|
| lexical docs | **5658** |
| lexical unique references | **1321** |
| accepted/eligible at build | **1376** |
| identifier Hit@5 | **5/5** |
| non-freshness MRR vs hybrid baseline | **0.8667 bit-identical** |
| global MRR | 0.8133 (freshness `prefer_order` incompletes on q-fresh-4/5 — TI-5ed2f2, not this bug) |

No lexical rebuild. Closing.
